**What this PR does / why we need it**:
Fixes a documentation bug in the encoding type required by the admission registration's webhook CA bundle field. It must be a string encoded as base64, not PEM.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Fixes https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/83469

**Special notes for your reviewer**:
Note it confused/misled a user here https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/61171#issuecomment-373031897
Documentation here correctly specifies base64 https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/extensible-admission-controllers/#configure-admission-webhooks-on-the-fly

issue_context.title: Documentation: api/admissionregistration has incorrect encoding type for webhook caBundle
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->


**What happened**:
The go documentation of the api/admissionregistration/v1beta1/WebhookClientConfig.caBundle says it is PEM encoded

**What you expected to happen**:
It should say base64-encoded

**How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)**:
It's just godoc

**Anything else we need to know?**:
It is correctly documented here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/extensible-admission-controllers/#configure-admission-webhooks-on-the-fly

review_comments: the base64 encoding is json/yaml-specific (proto it does not base64-encode)
See https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/75199 for a (stalled) effort to document this in all relevant places. If you want to pick that up that would be great
I see, that makes sense. I'll close this PR, as the other cover this and more.
